cohort: 150 full-term mothers aged 18-40 years admitted through the OPD or labor room of the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, in labor with full-term newborns without prenatal or perinatal complications.
finding: Newborns of mothers with iron deficiency anemia (IDA) had significantly lower hemoglobin and ferritin levels compared to newborns of non-anemic mothers.
